firecrawl_scrape._note: Record is top-level: {markdown, metadata}. `metadata` is an open per-page bag (og:*, robots, generator vary by site) with only scrapeId/sourceURL/url/statusCode/proxyUsed/cacheState/creditsUsed stable, so it is left unmodelled rather than typed from two pages. `markdown` is present only for the default formats=['markdown']; other `formats` values swap in html/links/screenshot keys, hence total=False.
firecrawl_scrape._discriminator_note: Pass 2 on `url` (3 sites) and `proxy` (basic/auto/enhanced) produced identical top-level shapes — inconclusive, not disproven.

firecrawl_map._discriminator_note: Pass 2 on `sitemap` (include/skip/only) gave identical element shapes; `only` returned an empty list for example.com (no sitemap), which is a data artifact, not a shape difference. Inconclusive, not disproven.

firecrawl_search._note: CONFIRMED polymorphism on the array param `sources` (not scalar, so the step-2e advisory never flagged it): sources=web returns data.web[{url,title,description,position}]; sources=news returns data.news[{title,url,snippet,date,imageUrl,position}]. `data` is therefore left unmodelled and only the stable envelope scalars are typed — a generic base model (step 4 option 2). Unwrapping to data.web would silently return [] for a news or images search.

firecrawl_monitor_list._note: The eval account holds no monitors, so `data` came back []. The element model is unobservable at probe time; `data: list` is the hand-added empty-list placeholder. Re-probe after creating a monitor to type the element.

firecrawl_parse._note: A local `filePath` does not return parsed content: it returns a presigned-upload handshake — {success, mode, message, upload{uploadUrl, uploadRef, fields{...}, expiresAt, maxSizeBytes}, nextToolCall{name, arguments{uploadRef}}, notes[]} — instructing the caller to upload out of band and re-call with `uploadRef`. `mode` is the response discriminator; the parsed-content mode was NOT observed, because reaching it needs a raw HTTP upload, which the skill forbids. Only the fields common to both modes are typed (step 4 option 2, generic base model). A .md file is rejected outright: 'Unsupported upload type'.
